findings.text: Public task switch wrapper preserves the guest instruction pointer, marks destination as absent, delegates to the internal switch routine, and on success restores the pointer and commits cached registers. An unhandleable inner result becomes a generic emulation failure while all other outcomes report success.

Task switching validates current and next descriptors, applies gate privilege screening, rejects absent or undersized targets, updates busy and nested task bookkeeping according to switch reason, dispatches to a width specific loader selected by descriptor type, then finalizes control state with task switched set, task register reload, optional error push sized by target width, and clearing of debug local controls.

Only gate induced switches with a software vector perform a privilege test. The gate descriptor privilege level must dominate both the selector request level and current privilege, otherwise a general protection fault tied to the vector is raised.

A thirty two bit task descriptor with scaled limit below 0x67 and a sixteen bit one below 0x2b is rejected as invalid with a task fault. Width follows the descriptor type width indicator and busy state is the second type bit.
String pointer advancement scales element size by repetition count and moves forward or backward according to the direction flag, then refreshes the memory effective address from the updated pointer.

Decimal adjust for subtraction corrects the low nibble by six when it exceeds nine or auxiliary carry was set, and corrects the high byte by ninety six when the original value exceeded ninety nine or carry was set, updating carry and auxiliary carry accordingly while arithmetic flags for zero sign and parity follow an OR with zero.

Adjust for division faults divide error on zero divisor then splits the low byte into quotient and remainder across high and low halves, while the multiply variant combines high times base plus low into the low byte. Both refresh parity zero and sign via an OR with zero.

Near relative calls capture the return pointer before branching then push it. Far calls load and validate a new code descriptor, capture old code state, push old selector and pointer, and on any later failure restore prior code state and mode. Near returns with an immediate pop the target pointer, branch to it, then bump the stack pointer by the immediate.
When a far call fails after pushing, guest memory may already be modified. The emulator restores code segment state and mode but cannot undo the partial push, emitting a one time warning about taint.

Register memory exchange writes the register side immediately and completes the memory side under an implicit locked operation. Three operand multiply forwards the second source before multiplying. Byte swap reverses order honoring operand width. Sign extension helpers propagate the source sign across the destination width. Plain move copies the whole value buffer.

Byte swapped moves require guest support and fault undefined otherwise. Sixteen bit form preserves the upper destination word, thirty two and sixty four bit forms fully replace the destination with reversed bytes, and any other width is treated as an internal bug.

Process identifier request reads the auxiliary timestamp register after checking guest support. Timestamp counter reads split a sixty four bit value across two general registers. Performance counter reads index by the counter selector register and fault general protection on backend failure, otherwise splitting the result similarly.

Control register writes go through a backend setter and suppress writeback, with control zero writes triggering a mode recalculation. Model specific register accesses combine or split two halves across accumulator halves and translate filtered faults into general protection. Extended control writes require operating system save support and likewise fault on backend rejection.

Only control zero, two through four, and eight are accepted, others fault undefined. Debug numbers above seven fault undefined, and aliases four and five fault undefined when exact matching is enabled. Privilege versus global detect fault ordering depends on vendor compatibility, with global detect raising debug. Debug writes mask values to mode width and screen status and control values for validity.

Segment selector stores and table pointer stores honor user mode instruction prevention when protection is enabled and privilege is nonzero, faulting general protection. Register to segment moves reject code and out of range selectors, with stack moves establishing a move shadow. Descriptor table loads and stores force eight byte size in sixty four bit mode, truncate sixteen bit addresses, reject noncanonical addresses, and suppress writeback. Machine status word stores truncate memory form and loads merge only the low nibble.

Page invalidation linearizes the operand for invalidation purposes before notifying the backend and suppresses writeback. Task flag clearing clears the task switched bit in control zero. Hypercalls invoke a fixup hook then rewind the instruction pointer so the fixed operation re executes, also suppressing writeback.

Loop decrements the count register then branches when the masked count remains nonzero and either the unconditional form or the matching zero condition holds. Jump on count zero branches only when the masked count equals zero.

Port input either completes synchronously or requests host assistance, while port output always delegates to the backend and suppresses writeback. Flag clear and set test privilege level and fault otherwise, with set establishing an interrupt shadow and setting the interrupt flag.

Processor identification requires host permission and otherwise faults, exchanging leaf and subleaf in accumulator registers and returning four result registers. Flag save and restore transfer the low flag byte to and from the high half of the accumulator low word, preserving the architectural fixed bit on restore.
Cache line flush and flush optimized are emulated as successful no operations without consulting feature bits.

Floating save area size equals a fixed header plus sixteen bytes per vector register, using sixteen registers in sixty four bit mode and otherwise eight when operating system vector support is enabled or zero when disabled.

Floating save and restore first validate vector support and control register task and emulation state, rejecting sixty four bit mode as unhandleable. Save captures host floating state under floating protection and writes the sized prefix to the memory operand. Restore reads the sized prefix, pads any missing tail from a fresh host capture, rejects nonzero reserved control bits, then restores under protection.

Restore with nonzero high half in the vector control word faults general protection. Sixty four bit floating operations report unhandleable rather than emulating. Debug writes that the backend rejects are treated as warnings converted to faults, and swapped moves with unsupported width trap as internal bugs.

Task finalization sets task switched in control zero and clears local breakpoint enable and slowdown in debug seven. Nested task tracks call and gate versus return from interrupt. Direction selects string stepping sign. User prevention, vector support, save support, and exact matching gate table, floating, extended control, and debug alias behavior.
